method_note: Editorial decision support, not a verified performance or quality rating. Scores use only the fields on the official CSLB records, company-published service statements and the owner-supplied quote wording, each re-read on 2026-11-08. No provider was contacted, no reference was taken and no availability or price was confirmed.

weights.criterion: Combined plumbing + building capability on one licence
weights.basis: B + C-36 on the checked CSLB record is relevant to combined plumbing and building work, subject to BPC §7057 and the actual scope. A named, appropriately qualified restoration party and contract structure remain to be confirmed.

weights.criterion: Evidence of this specific scope (tub waste-and-overflow / overflow access)
weights.basis: Company-published case evidence, owner-supplied quote wording, or indexed review text. Every item is labelled by strength; none is proof of this exact stuck-lever job.

weights.criterion: Licence standing and tenure on the official CSLB record
weights.basis: Current-and-active status, years since issue, workers-compensation record, bond record and any additional status or complaint disclosure. Active status is not an endorsement.
Published company statements about HOA/property-manager work, property maintenance or occupied-home protocol. Absence of a statement scores low; it is not evidence of inability.

weights.criterion: Price evidence for a comparable scope
weights.basis: Only owner-supplied quote wording dated 2026-08-30 is available; those amounts are owner-reported and not verified. No provider has issued a document to this project.

ranked.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: Broadest single-licence coverage in the set: B + C-36 plus A, C-4, C-16 and C-10 on the CSLB record, a useful combination for a potential single prime contract, subject to the actual scope, contract structure and applicable licensing rules. Licensed since 2003 with a current workers-compensation policy; the company advertises HOA and property-manager work, which matches a tenant-occupied building. Indexed review text mentions bathtub repair, but no source shows this trip-lever job.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. Owner-supplied comparators for replacement-type scopes are $550 and $614 (owner-reported, unverified); the official DBI Category 1P plumbing fee is $290 if a permit applies (a fee, not a price).
ranked.ask: Ask for one written combined scope: tub-side attempt first, ceiling opening method, named drywall/texture party, occupied-unit schedule, and a fixed price with the permit position stated. Final verification gate: Confirm drywall/texture/paint party, occupied-unit protections and small-job acceptance.
ranked.short_why: broadest single-licence coverage (B + C-36 plus A, C-4, C-16, C-10), active since 2003 with current workers comp and published HOA/property-manager work

ranked.name: Heise’s Plumbing
ranked.legal_name: TARO GROUP INC · dba HEISES PLUMBING
ranked.why: Heise’s publishes a San Francisco tub waste-and-overflow case describing exterior-ceiling access and separately advertises plumbing-access patching, ceiling patching and paint touch-ups. Both are company claims, not independent proof of performance or acceptance of this job. Its CSLB licence lists C-36, C-10, A and C-20, but not B or C-9; confirm the restoration party and licensing/contract structure. The case page embeds a 404 template block.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. The published case does not state a price, and no ceiling-restoration line is priced anywhere in the sources.
ranked.ask: Ask whether one contract covers both trades, who performs and warrants ceiling patch/texture/paint, the applicable licensing and scope, occupied-unit protections, a direct reference, and an itemized two-path price.
ranked.short_why: published ceiling-access overflow case and advertised plumbing-access drywall and ceiling patching; restoration party and contract structure unconfirmed

ranked.name: Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: B + C-36 combined licence and a published offer that runs from simple repairs to complete renovations, which is the shortest single-contract path if the ceiling has to be opened. The licence was issued in 2024 and the CSLB record shows a workers-compensation exemption (certified no employees), so crew size and supervision should be confirmed. The indexed Yelp account describes retrieving a tub plug by opening a wall; it is adjacent evidence, not this job.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. Owner-supplied comparators are $550 and $614 for replacement-type scopes (unverified); no labour or restoration line is documented.
ranked.ask: Ask whether the crew is employees or subcontractors, who patches and textures the ceiling, and for a fixed combined price. Final verification gate: Name restoration party; confirm occupied-unit plan, insurance, permit path and current phone.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 with a published simple-repair-to-renovation offer; 2024 licence and workers-comp exemption to check

ranked.name: Ayoob & Peery
ranked.why: B + C-36 with C-4, C-16 and C-20, licensed since 1980 and carrying a current workers-compensation policy: the strongest tenure and standing among combined-classification leads. No published tub waste-and-overflow case, no occupied-unit statement and no quote were found, so it ranks on capability rather than evidence.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. No published pricing for this scope was found.
ranked.ask: Ask whether the firm takes small occupied-unit repair work at all, then request the same combined written scope.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36, licensed since 1980 with current workers comp; no scope evidence yet

ranked.name: We Do Construction
ranked.why: B + C-36 with a current workers-compensation policy covering subcontracted construction work. The indexed description positions kitchens and baths inside larger renovation scopes, so a small single-fixture repair may not be accepted; no tub-overflow case or quote was found.
ranked.ask: Ask first whether a one-fixture repair with ceiling patching is in scope, then request the combined written scope. Final verification gate: Confirm minimum job size, restoration self-performance and occupied-unit plan.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 with current workers comp, but positioned toward larger renovations

ranked.name: Expert Plumbing Solutions
ranked.why: The supplied 2026-08-30 wording — "replace waste and overflow" — is the closest of the three owner-supplied scopes to the actual work, and the CSLB record has been active since 2012 with a current workers-compensation policy. C-36 only: the licence does not cover the ceiling repair, so a second licensed party is required if the ceiling is opened. This ranking does not endorse the $614 figure, which remains owner-reported.
ranked.cost_note: Owner-reported $614 on 2026-08-30 for "replace waste and overflow". Verified amount blank; no access route, drywall restoration, permit, cleanup or warranty line is included.
ranked.ask: Requote the identical combined scope and ask for the access method and the named restoration party in writing. Final verification gate: Confirm access route, parts, drywall, permit, cleanup, warranty and validity in writing.
ranked.short_why: C-36 only; owner-reported $614 is the closest supplied scope wording

ranked.name: Save-On-Interior
ranked.why: B + C-36 at the same registered address and phone as Bay Area Plumbing, which makes it the natural second half of that firm's combined scope if the relationship is confirmed. The CSLB record also carries 2015–2016 cash-deposit letters, and the workers-compensation record is an exemption (no employees), so entity and crew questions come before price.
ranked.cost_note: No quote on file. Owner-reported $550 exists for Bay Area Plumbing only; that price cannot be attributed to this licence.
ranked.ask: Ask whether the two licence holders operate as one contracting entity, and which licence would sign the contract.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 at Bay Area Plumbing’s address and phone; entity relationship unconfirmed

ranked.name: Bay Area Plumbing
ranked.why: Long-standing C-36 licence (since 1999) with an owner-reported $550 for "lever, plug and spout with diverter, labor and materials". Those words may describe a spout/diverter assembly rather than the waste-and-overflow body, which is the part at issue, so the price may not cover this job. C-36 only, with a workers-compensation exemption; the shared address and phone with Save-On-Interior do not by themselves prove common ownership.
ranked.cost_note: Owner-reported $550 on 2026-08-30 for lever, plug and spout with diverter, labour and materials. Verified amount blank; scope wording may not match the failed assembly.
ranked.ask: Confirm in writing that the price covers the overflow body and linkage, not only the spout/diverter, and who restores the ceiling. Final verification gate: Confirm legal contracting entity, license, exact parts and restoration party before comparison.
ranked.short_why: C-36 only; owner-reported $550 may describe a spout/diverter rather than the overflow body

ranked.name: Discount Plumbing Rooter Services
ranked.why: C-36 + A with an unusually complete insurance file on the CSLB record: workers compensation, $2,000,000 liability and a $100,000 LLC employee bond. No B or C-9, and no tub-overflow or occupied-unit evidence was found; the licence was issued in 2025 and the firm is registered in Burlingame.
ranked.ask: Ask whether San Francisco occupied-unit repair work is accepted and who holds the drywall classification.
ranked.short_why: C-36 + A with $2M liability and LLC bond on file; no building classification

ranked.name: Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.legal_name: JOSEPH TINSLEY · dba FAST RESPONSE PLUMBING AND ROOTER
ranked.why: The $135 owner-reported price is for "repair or adjust plunger handle", an adjustment rather than a replacement, so it is not comparable to the other two. C-36 only; the CSLB workers-compensation policy expires 2026-12-18, before some likely work dates, and the registered address wording differs from the website.
ranked.cost_note: Owner-reported $135 on 2026-08-30 for repair or adjust of the plunger handle. Verified amount blank; adjustment-only scope, not a replacement-plus-access price.
ranked.ask: Ask what happens if adjustment fails, and request a replacement scope with ceiling access priced separately. Final verification gate: Clarify whether adjustment can free this stuck assembly; price fallback separately.
ranked.short_why: C-36 only; the $135 quote is adjustment-only, and workers comp expires 2026-12-18

partner.name: Bernal Hill Drywall
partner.why: C-9 drywall plus B, active since 2014 with a current workers-compensation policy. This is the only drywall specialist in the register, and it is a restoration partner for whichever plumbing lead is hired, not a candidate for the plumbing work itself (no C-36).
partner.cost_note: No quote on file. No patch/texture/paint price has been supplied by any party.
partner.ask: Ask for a fixed patch-texture-paint price conditional on a defined opening size, and whether work can be scheduled after the plumbing inspection. Final verification gate: Pair with licensed plumber under lawful combined contract; confirm ceiling finish match and contents protection.
partner.short_why: C-9 + B drywall specialist, paired with a plumbing lead

not_recommended.name: D G Construction
not_recommended.reason: B + C-36 capability, but the official CSLB record links to complaint disclosure and the disclosure lists citation 2 2022 002099 dated 2023-03-23 (for disclosure only per B&P §7124.6). The citation substance is not published on that page, so treat as hold until reviewed.

not_recommended.name: SF Building Group
not_recommended.reason: B only on the checked record, registered in South San Francisco, workers-compensation exemption. Without C-36 the plumbing work needs a separate licensed plumber, so it cannot be the single all-in-one contract.

not_recommended.name: 24/7 SF Handyman & Remodeling Service
not_recommended.reason: B-2 Residential Remodeling only; no plumbing classification, so it cannot lawfully take the pipe work itself.

not_recommended.name: Advanced Plumbing and Drain
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only, and the CSLB record carries an additional status warning that the licence may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability. Resolve that before any inquiry.

not_recommended.name: Caccia Home Services
not_recommended.reason: C-36 with C-31, C-34 and C-10, no building or drywall classification, registered in Burlingame. No tub-overflow or occupied-unit evidence found.

not_recommended.name: Flow Masters Plumbing
not_recommended.reason: C-36 with C-16 and C-20 only, registered in Daly City, no building or drywall classification and no evidence for this scope.

not_recommended.name: FDL Plumbing
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only, registered in Daly City, workers-compensation exemption, no building classification and no evidence for this scope.

not_recommended.name: Citywide Plumbing
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only, workers-compensation exemption, and the CSLB record shows the licence was reissued to another entity on 2026-07-06 — confirm the current operator before relying on older reputation.

not_recommended.name: Precision Rooter & Drain
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only with a workers-compensation exemption; the indexed description is drain cleaning and rooter work rather than fixture or overflow replacement.

not_recommended.name: Clever Plumbing & Rooter
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only, registered in San Bruno, workers-compensation exemption, and the licence was issued on 2026-09-04 — no track record yet for delicate occupied-unit work.

not_recommended.name: Cahill Contractors
not_recommended.reason: A + B general contractor with no plumbing classification; this is a large commercial builder, not a one-fixture repair provider.

not_recommended.name: Kenneth Asire Plumbing
not_recommended.reason: Licence is suspended for a contractors-bond suspension on the checked record. Do not hire while suspended.

not_recommended.name: Portola Plumbing Services
not_recommended.reason: Identity unresolved: no licence number, phone, address or status could be matched on the official CSLB lookup. Every field is left blank.

not_recommended.name: Atlas Plumbing & Rooter
not_recommended.reason: Active C-36 San Francisco plumbing lead. An unverified Yelp search excerpt mentions stuck bathtub drain levers and the BBB profile lists adjacent drain work, but no B/C-9 or ceiling-restoration proof was found. CSLB, company and BBB phone numbers differ. Hold as a conditional review lead until a direct trip-lever reference, restoration party and current dispatch number are confirmed.

final_verification_note: Final integration on 2026-11-08 re-fetched all 24 CSLB records, added Atlas as a conditional hold, corrected the AmLegal chunk reference, and added phone-discrepancy flags. The weighted order remains editorial decision support, not a verified performance rating; no provider was contacted or booked.
